findings.description: Fresh PostgreSQL deployment aborts migration 035 at line 6 because LOCK TABLE executes outside a transaction block.
findings.resolution: Wrap migration 035 preflight, lock, and DDL in one explicit transaction; recreate an empty database and rerun live projection tests.

findings.description: Affected coordinator tests reported 142 passed and 16 skipped; the skipped cases are the real PostgreSQL projection tests.
findings.resolution: Run the integration module against the corrected isolated PostgreSQL deployment with zero projection-test skips.

findings.description: Context-impact validation rejects wp-contracts and wp-integration for omitted documentation, APIs, and semantic-code surfaces.
findings.resolution: Declare every inferred surface and rerun validate_context_impact.py.

findings.description: Full coordinator suite: 2435 passed, 92 skipped, 7 failed; full skills suite stopped with 36 collection import errors.
findings.resolution: Separate baseline/order-sensitive failures from regressions and repair shared test import isolation.

findings.description: Architecture freshness failed because root configuration targets absent src, database/migrations, and web paths.
findings.resolution: Correct source roots, refresh the graph, and rerun architecture diff and scoped flows.

findings.description: Live DAST and endpoint security checks could not run because the API never started after the migration failure.
findings.resolution: Restore deployability and rerun live security review; preventive Tier-3 searches were clean but do not replace DAST.
